environment: Chromium 141 headless (SwiftShader), Linux container, local game server behind a stall/cut relay

checks.name: server that never answers: the player is told it is unreachable (not stuck on "Connecting…")

detail.msg: Could not reach the game server.

checks.name: stall: two browsers in an online match
stall: "Reconnecting…" shows when the network drops
stall: when the network returns the player is back in the same match (a hung attempt no longer blocks it)
network never returns: the "connection lost" screen with a way home, within the grace period
network never returns: "Main menu" works
engine download fails: says it did not load and offers Reload (not "no 3D graphics")

detail.msg: Part of the game did not load. This is usually a brief connection problem, or the site was just updated. Reload the page to try again. Reload page

checks.name: engine download fails: Reload brings the game back
mission download fails: says so and offers Reload (not "connection to the room ended")

detail.msg: The mission did not load (a connection problem, or the site was just updated). Reload the page to try again. Your progress is saved.

checks.name: mission download fails: no unhandled error from the background prefetch
after Reload the mission starts; 12 rapid menu toggles while loading leave a playable state
context lost: "Graphics paused" explains it, practice pauses, held keys are released
context restored: the notice goes away, Resume returns to a drawing match
context not restored: after 8 s the notice adds that reloading usually fixes it
context loss: no page errors
frames keep failing: "The game stopped" screen appears (not a silent frozen picture)
Copy diagnostics: the report has the build, mode, the error and the frame-error count
Copy diagnostics: no room code in the report
"Back to the menu" leaves the match and the game draws again
a new practice match starts normally afterwards
backgrounded with W and D held: menu opens, practice pauses, nothing stays held
clipboard refused: the report is shown in a selectable box instead
back from the background and the box: Resume returns to play
